rt.title: PLTS 100 GWp supply chain: programme demand and local manufacturer supply | METI Directory
rt.deskripsi: Is local solar module supply enough for the 100 GWp solar programme? Capacity of 40 manufacturers, exports, local content, and factory locations, sourced and dated.
rt.judul: PLTS 100 GWp supply chain: is local supply enough?
rt.kebutuhan: Programme demand and manufacturer capacity per year
rt.jawab: If the 100 GWp programme is completed within {n} years, it needs about {butuh} GWp per year (EST). Module makers serving the local market have {lokal} GWp per year, about {persen}% of that need; of the {total} GWp per year in total, {ekspor} GWp is export-oriented.
rt.k.ekspor_cat: includes {gw} GWp from makers serving both local and export
rt.k.program_cat: first {n} projects of the {target} GWp target; not yet installed
rt.b.label: Programme need versus manufacturer capacity, GWp per year
rt.horizon_cat: Target {target} GWp divided by {n} years. The source gives no completion date, so this is a scenario.
rt.peta_label: Map of Indonesia with circles at cities hosting solar module factories
rt.peta_cat: Dots are city centres from the source table (METI approximation), not factory coordinates; circle size follows MWp per city.
rt.cara1: Need per year = programme target {target} GWp divided by the number of years. The source gives no completion date, so 5, 8, or 10 years is a scenario (Hypothesis), not an official target.
rt.cara2: Manufacturer capacity is the MWp per year column of the DJEBTKE ESDM table on solar module manufacturers, summed as given. Export-oriented = export market plus makers serving both (18.3 GWp), so pure local supply is a lower bound.
rt.cara3: Manufacturers that have not reported capacity (cells marked -) are not counted. Installed factory capacity is not actual output.
rt.cara4: TKDN: local content level, percent per the source table. BMP: company benefit weight, as given in the source table. APAMSI: Indonesian Solar Module Manufacturers Association.
rt.cara5: The share of need met by local supply is derived (EST): local-market manufacturer capacity divided by yearly need.
rt.kutip: Cite as: METI Directory, PLTS supply chain page, data frozen {tanggal}. Manufacturer source: DJEBTKE ESDM table on solar module manufacturers in Indonesia.
as.title: ASEAN: Indonesia's position in electricity mix and access | METI Directory
as.deskripsi: Comparison of 10 ASEAN countries: renewable electricity share, renewable capacity, and electricity access, 10-year trend, with sources and dates.
as.jawab: Indonesia ranks {r} of {n} ASEAN countries in renewable electricity share ({v}% in {tahun}), {rk} of {nk} in renewable capacity, and {ra} of {na} in electricity access.
as.tren_label: Trend in {metrik}, last 10 years, 10 ASEAN countries with Indonesia highlighted
as.cara1: Renewable electricity share: percent of electricity generation from renewable sources (Ember, via Our World in Data, CC BY 4.0). Renewable capacity: IRENASTAT, total renewables in MW (Brunei not listed). Electricity access: World Bank WDI, percent of population.
as.cara2: Ranks are computed by METI from each country's latest-year value; the latest year can differ between countries (shown on each bar). Trends use the last 10 yearly points.
as.cara3: Change in the trend table is derived (EST): percentage-point difference for share and access, relative change for capacity. Share measures the generation mix, capacity measures installed power; they are not the same.
as.kutip: Cite as: METI Directory, ASEAN page, data frozen {tanggal}. Sources: Ember via Our World in Data, IRENASTAT, World Bank WDI.
tn.title: About METI and the METI Directory
tn.deskripsi: About METI, the 2025-2028 board, partners, and how the METI Directory is compiled from dated public sources.
tn.lead: METI is an association of renewable energy players in Indonesia. This directory records projects, organisations, people, and regulations. Every figure has a source and a date.
tn.meti.isi: METI was founded in 1999. Its members are companies, associations, academics, and individuals working in renewable energy.
tn.dir.isi: This directory is for METI members. Every row has a source link and a date. Calculated figures are labelled EST. Scores and quadrants are labelled Hypothesis. Personal data is not shown.
tn.struktur.pengantar: Board for the {periode} term. Click a unit to see its members.
tn.struktur.sumber: Source: the metiires.or.id team page, retrieved {tanggal}.
tn.u.muda_isi: Network of young renewable energy professionals
tn.mitra.pengantar: METI's partners and member companies. Each logo belongs to its owner and was taken from the metiires.or.id partnership page on {tanggal}.
tn.metode.isi: Data comes from official documents, company filings, organisation websites, and open data. Each fact records its source, date, and level of evidence. The server keeps public, member, and staff layers apart. Wrong data can be reported with the edit button on a profile.
tn.kontak.isi: Send data corrections or partnership offers to the address below.
tn.kredit.pengantar: Photos come from Wikimedia Commons under free licences and are stored on this server.
